name: format_centimes
rule: docs/features.md §4 Printing: an amount is shown as grouped dinars, a comma, then exactly two centime digits, with no currency word and Western digits in every language. Thousands are grouped with a narrow no-break space, U+202F, which stands in the expected strings below as itself and looks like a space that a copy and paste must not turn into an ordinary one. A quantity is thousandths of the unit, comma decimal, trailing zeros trimmed, and it is never grouped: 1000000 is a thousand units, not a total.
runners: crates/core/tests/money_fixtures.rs (dzpos_core::money::format) and packages/shared/src/money.test.ts (formatCentimes, formatQty). The printed ticket and the screen show the same amount because both read this file.
